routing: Modular in routes/Admin/*.php, auto-loaded by web.php
controllers: Resourceful, inline validation, Spatie permissions in constructor
frontend: DashboardLayout is standard, UI components from Components/UI, no native HTML buttons/tables
state: No Axios for fetching lists. Data provided by Inertia. Flash sessions for alerts.
naming: PascalCase for React components, snake_case for DB columns
